messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: inference-api high 5xx rate (>= 5% over 3m) in us-west-2. Alert: SRE.P1. Pager: @oncall. thread created 2019876543

Alex: taking pager — looking at logs and grafana right now. any customer-facing errors reported?

Maria: I'm on logs. 503s look like upstream model pool OOMs when we hit cold-started dedicated nodes. KV cache shows lower hit-rate (~12%) during spike.

Alex: good catch. I'll scale the model pool and bump the replica count on the problematic variant. Scaling command: `infra scale-model-pool --model redwood-7b-quant --replicas 8`

Jonas: FYI starting a canary fallback to quantized-compat variant in us-west-2: `routing set-fallback --from redwood-7b --to redwood-7b-quant-compat --region us-west-2`

Priya: handing over to @Priya (next oncall) at 12:48 UTC. docs updated in #oncall-handovers.

Priya: after scaling and fallback, 5xx rate dropped to 1.1% in the last 2m. still seeing p99 latency spikes ~1.8s vs baseline 1.0s.

product-ops: any customer impact? we saw two support tickets for delayed completions.

Alex: support ticket mapping: 5 customers likely affected for ~5-12 minutes each. no billing incidents. will add to post-incident notes.

Maria: post-mortem action: alert noise — threshold was 5% over 3m; we had lots of transient blips. propose: change to >=4% over 5m and add a sustained-evaluation rule (>=3% for 15m) to catch slow regressions.

Priya: agree. also add a suppression rule to avoid paging for single-minute spikes when traffic < 50rps.

Taylor: for the retro dashboard, proposing panels:
 - Golden signals: p50/p95/p99 latency, request rate, error rate
 - Model pool metrics: OOM count, queue depth, replica churn
 - Cache metrics: KV cache hit-rate over time
 - Routing fallbacks: count of fallback events per region
 - Error budget burn: rolling burn rate
Include drilldowns: click p99 -> traces (tempo), click error rate -> last 24h logs filter

Priya: can someone create the Grafana dashboard `retro/inference-incident-2019876543` with those panels? tag it `incident-retro` and set 30d timepicker default.

Jonas: I'll stub the panels, putting queries below. adding as code block.

```sql
-- p99 latency
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) FROM requests WHERE service='inference-api' AND region='us-west-2' GROUP BY time(1m)

-- error rate
SELECT sum(errors)/sum(requests) FROM service_metrics WHERE service='inference-api' GROUP BY time(1m)
```

Alex: +1. Add an alert change PR referencing #1819001234 and link to this thread.

product-ops: please record customer impact in the ticket with timestamps.

Priya: created issue infra/OBS-342 titled "Grafana: retro dashboard for inference incident 2019876543". assign: Jonas. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Maria: follow-up tasks:
- tweak alert thresholds (alerts/420)
- add suppression rule (alerts/421)
- dashboard creation (infra/OBS-342)
- run an eval of cache warmup strategy (infra/OBS-343)

Priya: summary: mitigation successful, limited customer impact, action items assigned. moving this to #postmortems for write-up. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident SRE.P1 resolved (duration 21m). closing pager.
